body:
New features
- remove plots from docs
- disable partitioner and processor (processor will be moved to GriddingMachineDatasets for offline use only)
- remove support to ERA5 data fetch (no need to use Julia to call Python)
- add new Vcmax25 datasets
- new auto expansion function
- more MODIS data fetch functions
- move all GriddingMachine artifacts to local folders (instead of along with real Julia artifacts)
- option of not requesting std
- new function to request data used for Emerald space

Starting from v0.3 (in the next release), the Artifacts.toml file will be removed. In this case, there is no need to upgrade GriddingMachine when no datasets are available.
title: Last v0.2 stable release before switching to v0.3
